microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.label: Nexus Chat microphone
microphone.hint: The microphone listened to when you talk to Nexus Chat (mic button or the "Talk to Nexus Chat" shortcut). Used from the next recording on.
microphone.missingHint: The chosen microphone is not plugged in: the system default stands in for it until it is back.
microphone.saveError: Could not save the chosen microphone.
microphone.readError: Could not read the chosen microphone.
microphone.testQuiet: Next to nothing was picked up: check that it is the right microphone and that it is not muted.
microphone.testSilent: Complete silence: Windows passes nothing on. In Windows Settings › Privacy › Microphone, check that desktop apps may use the microphone, and that it is not muted.
microphone.testInUse: The microphone is already in use by Nexus Chat in the other window.
microphone.testFailed: The microphone could not open. Check that it is plugged in.
